lyrics:
[Intro: whistled melody, fingerpicked guitar]

[Verse 1: soft kind male voice]
Old man on the next chair over
Hat on his face, half asleep
Said, "Son, you look like I did
Running on nothing but speed"

[Chorus: bouncing bass, guitar, whistle after each line]
"Drink some water
Call your mother
Get some sleep, it's not a crime
Say you're sorry sooner
That's the whole list. Took me a lifetime."

[Drop: whistled melody, bass and kick, no vocal]

[Verse 2: voice warmer, shaker in]
I laughed, then I thought about it
Forty feet of pool and sky
He was snoring by the second verse
I wrote it on my hand to keep it dry

[Chorus: bouncing bass, guitar, whistle after each line]
"Drink some water
Call your mother
Get some sleep, it's not a crime
Say you're sorry sooner
That's the whole list. Took me a lifetime."

[Drop: whistled melody, fuller, handclaps]

[Outro: guitar and whistle, a phone dialing, spoken]
Hi, Mom. No, nothing's wrong.
